200.q: I have teeth but never bite, and I get pulled up and down all day. What am I?
I have a tongue but no mouth, a sole but no soul, and laces to keep me shut. What am I?
I have a spine but no bones, and leaves but no branches. What am I?
I have four legs and a back, but I'm the one who gets sat on. What am I?
I have branches but no leaves, no trunk, and no fruit, yet people trust me with their savings. What am I?
I fly without wings and cry without eyes. What am I?
I have bark but never bite, and my rings give away how old I am. What am I?
I have a stem and a bowl, but I'm not a flower and I hold no soup. What am I?
I have a bridge but no river, a neck but no head, and six strings. What am I?
I have blades but I'm not a knife, and I spin above your head to keep you cool. What am I?
I have a trunk and a hood but no face, and I spend the night in the driveway. What am I?
I have ribs but no heart, and I only open when the rain comes. What am I?
I have a head and a foot but no body, and you lie on me every night. What am I?
I have a mouth and a neck but no head, and I hold flowers. What am I?
I have a handle and a spout, and I whistle when I'm ready. What am I?
I have a tail and I fly, but only while you hold my string. What am I?
I have four strings, I'm played with a bow, and I'm tucked under your chin. What am I?
I have eyes but cannot see, and I'm dug up, mashed, and fried. What am I?
I have a head but never think, and my head is nothing but foam. What am I?
I have teeth along my edge, and I cut wood by going back and forth. What am I?
I have a tongue but never taste, and my ringing calls people to church. What am I?
I have springs but no water, and I bounce you into the air. What am I?
I have a deck but no cards, a bow but no arrow, and a stern that's never angry. What am I?
I have a brim but no cup, and I sit on top of your head. What am I?
I have a collar but no neck, and sleeves but no arms. What am I?
I have a heel and a toe but no foot of my own, and I often lose my twin in the wash. What am I?
I have leaves but no branches, and I'm steeped in hot water. What am I?
I have a thumb but no fingers, and I keep your hand warm. What am I?
I have a foot but no leg, and I keep your lines straight. What am I?
I have a seat but no legs, and I hang from a branch on two ropes. What am I?
I have a spout, and I rain on the flowers whenever you tip me. What am I?
I have a head, and I only light up when I'm struck. What am I?
I always point north but never travel anywhere. What am I?
I'm knocked on but never hurt, and answered though I never ask a question. What am I?
I have a bridge but no river, and two arms that hook behind your ears. What am I?
I have a lip but never speak, a handle but never grab, and I hold your morning coffee. What am I?
I have a crust, a mantle, and a core, but I'm not a pie. What am I?

400.q: I have pupils but I'm not an eye, and a bell tells me when to start. What am I?
I can be cracked, made, told, and played, but I only work if you laugh. What am I?
I have a crown but no throne, and a root but no leaves. What am I?
I have a shoulder but no arm, and I pass through towns without ever moving. What am I?
I was never alive, yet I can die, and when I do, everything I power goes dark. What am I?
I have four wheels and flies, but I never leave the ground. What am I?
I go in hard and come out soft, and you can blow me into a bubble. What am I?
I have an eye but cannot see, and I'm calm at my center while everything around me is wild. What am I?
I have a tail made of ice and dust, and I only grow it when I get close to the sun. What am I?
I'm the only kind of coat you put on while it's wet. What am I?
I'm taken, shot, and framed, but I've never committed a crime. What am I?
I can be caught but never thrown, and I'm most common in winter. What am I?
I'm drawn without a pencil, I run without legs, and I'm taken hot. What am I?
I run without legs and drop without falling, and the saddest people make the most of me. What am I?
I can be kept, given, and broken, but never touched. What am I?
I fly all day but never go anywhere. What am I?
I have a heel but no foot, and a crust but no dirt. What am I?
I'm full of dates but never go on one, and I'm thrown away every twelve months. What am I?
I have a fly but never buzz, and two legs but never walk. What am I?
I come in a hand but never on an arm, and monkeys can't get enough of me. What am I?
I have a bridge but no river, and I run when you're sick. What am I?
I have a drum and a canal, but no music and no boats. What am I?
I can be cast, broken, and lifted, and witches are famous for me. What am I?
I have a train but no tracks, and I'm usually worn only once. What am I?
I have an ear but cannot hear, and I'm dressed in silk and husk. What am I?
I'm drawn every evening, but never with a pencil, and I hide you from the street. What am I?
I'm held to keep you quiet and bitten to stop a remark. What am I?
I'm an insect, but I also crash your software. What am I?

600.q: Spelled forward I'm heavy; spelled backward I'm not. What am I?
I stand on one leg with my heart in my head. What am I?
I have a foot on each end and one in the middle. What am I?
I wear a belt of three stars and hunt across the winter sky. What am I?
I break at dawn, I'm called at dusk, and heroes are always saving me. What am I?
I'm served in prison, and I end with a full stop. What am I?
I'm found at the end of every rainbow, though no gold sits beside me. What am I?
There are two of me in a corner, one in a room, none in a house, but one in a shelter. What am I?
I'm lost, kept, and held, and I go quickest in an argument. What am I?
I'm paid but never bought, caught but never thrown, and held but never touched. What am I?
I'm set, broken, and beaten, yet I never feel a thing. What am I?
I have a heart but no other organs, and I'm eaten leaf by leaf. What am I?
I'm a seven-letter word, yet I hold thousands of letters. What am I?
I'm a word for shining your shoes, but give me a capital letter and I become a nationality. What am I?
Most of me hides below the surface, I'm lighter than the water I came from, and ships fear me. What am I?
Flip me upside down and I'm worth half again as much. What am I?
I read the same forwards, backwards, and upside down, and I'm the middle of the day. What am I?
I'm a five-letter word you might skip across a pond; drop my first two letters and I become a number. What am I?
I come to you every night, but I'm usually gone by breakfast. What am I?
I'm a single letter, but said aloud I'm a hot drink, and I'm the front half of a very common shirt. What am I?
Turn me once, and what's out will not get in; turn me again, and what's in will not get out. What am I?
I'm the everyday English word with three sets of double letters in a row. What am I?
No matter how many times you add me to myself, I never grow. What am I?
Read me forward and I'm what everyone has done; read me backward and I'm someone you'd rather never meet. What am I?
Read me backward and I become the sweetest course of the meal. What am I?
The longer you hold me, the heavier I become, yet I weigh nothing at all. What am I?
